title: PTGPO: Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.14737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training language agents on long-horizon interactive tasks is challenging because sparse terminal rewards provide weak credit signals for intermediate actions. Existing group-based methods either assign a shared trajectory-level advantage or estimate step-level advantages from state groups, which may conflate the current action with subsequent decisions. We propose Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization (PTGPO), a critic-free method that constructs prefix trees over trajectory suffixes within anchor-state groups. PTGPO assigns each tree edge a credit given by the difference between its child and parent empirical mean returns, capturing the conditional return change revealed by each additional action. These prefix-tree credits provide fine-grained learning signals without requiring a critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on interactive benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop and Sokoban show that PTGPO consistently improves over RL baselines,

translated_abstract: 在长时程交互任务上训练语言智能体具有挑战性，因为稀疏的终端奖励只能为中间动作提供微弱的信用信号。现有的基于群组的方法要么分配共享的轨迹级优势，要么从状态组中估计步骤级优势，这可能将当前动作与后续决策混淆。我们提出了前缀树组策略优化（PTGPO），这是一种无需评论家（critic-free）的方法，它在锚点状态组内对轨迹后缀构建前缀树。PTGPO为树的每条边分配一个信用值，该信用值由其子节点与父节点的经验平均回报之差给出，从而捕捉每一步额外动作所揭示的条件回报变化。这些前缀树信用提供了细粒度的学习信号，而无需评论家网络或额外的 rollout。在交互式基准测试 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Sokoban 上的实验表明，PTGPO 持续优于强化学习基线。
tldr: PTGPO通过在锚点状态组内构建轨迹后缀前缀树，利用子父节点经验平均回报之差为每条树边分配信用，无需评论家网络即可提供细粒度学习信号，在ALFWorld、WebShop和Sokoban等长时程交互任务上持续优于强化学习基线。
en_tdlr: PTGPO constructs prefix trees over trajectory suffixes within anchor-state groups and assigns credits via differences between child and parent empirical mean returns, providing critic-free fine-grained learning signals that consistently outperform RL baselines on long-horizon interactive tasks.
